Unmake: All enemy champions within 650 units take 12% increased magic damage.
(Unmake's damage bonus does not stack.)
+35 Ability Power / +4% Move Speed

Endurance: While in combat with enemy champions, gain 1 Endurance stack each second, up to 5 stacks. At max stacks, gain 20% increased size, 20% Tenacity, 30% bonus Armor, and 30% bonus Magic Resistance until leaving champion combat.

Awe: Grants bonus Ability Power equal to 1% maximum Mana. Refunds 25% of Mana spent.
Mana Charge: Increases max Mana by 14 every time Mana is spent. Caps at 700 bonus Mana, transforming Archangel's Staff into Seraph's Embrace. Triggers up to 3 times every 10 seconds. You may only carry one Tear of the Goddess item at a time.
Censer: Shielding or healing an allied champion other than yourself empowers both you and that champion for 6 seconds, granting 30% bonus Attack Speed and 25 bonus magic damage on basic attacks.
Cloudwalker: Gain 20 out-of-combat Movement Speed.

Block: Basic attacks from champions deal 10% reduced damage to you.
Noxian Endurance: Taking physical damage from champions grants a physical shield equal to 20–140 + 5% of your maximum Health for 5 seconds. (12 second Cooldown)
+40 Attack Damage
Cinders: Deals 10–20 magic damage per second to nearby enemies. (Deals 115% damage against minions and monsters instead.)
+20 Ability Power / +10 Ability Haste / +50% Base Mana Regen
Annul: Grants a spell shield that blocks the next enemy ability (30 second Cooldown).
Blessed Blade: Attacks restore 10 Health on hit.

Sunder: Dealing physical damage to a champion reduces their Armor by 6% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times for 30% reduction.
Rage: Gain 20 Movement Speed when you deal physical damage, and gain 40 Movement Speed when moving toward enemy champions with 5 Sunder stacks. Ranged champions gain halved values.

Baleful Blaze: Damaging abilities burn enemies, dealing an additional 20 + 2% Ability Power magic damage per second for 3 seconds.
Against monsters, they deal 40 + 2% Ability Power magic damage per second.
Blackfire: Each enemy champion or monster affected by your Baleful Blaze grants you 4% Ability Power.

Ruined Strikes: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage on hit equal to 6% of the target's current Health (8% for melee), with a minimum of 15 and a maximum of 100 against monsters.
Drain: Hitting the same enemy champion 3 times with basic attacks or abilities slows them by 30% for 1.5 seconds (30 second Cooldown).
+40 Ability Power
Vile Decay: When abilities or passives deal magic damage to champions, reduce their Magic Resist by 7.5% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 30%.
Ichorshield: Convert overhealing from your Lifesteal into a shield that absorbs up to 165–345 damage (based on level).
UNIQUE - Strike: +10 Armor penetration.

Equilibrium: Champions without Mana gain 50% increased Base Health Regen.
Big Bully: Attacks and active abilities deal 18 bonus true damage to minions.
+25 Move Speed. 400

Entwine: Apply 40% Grievous Wounds to enemy champions for 3 seconds when struck by their attacks or when dealing damage to them.

+20 Armor 500
Spellweaver: Dealing magic damage or true damage to champions grants 30 bonus Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

Summoned: Reduces Summoner Spell cooldowns by 20%.
Noxian Haste: Healing or shielding an allied champion, casting an ability, or dealing ability damage to an enemy grants Movement Speed (10% for melee champions / 8% for ranged champions) for 4 seconds.
The same ability can only trigger this once every 4 seconds.

Life from Death: Whenever an enemy champion dies within 3 seconds of taking damage from you, create a nova at their location that heals allied champions for 100 + 20% Ability Power Health. (60 second Cooldown)
+12% Attack Speed

Dawnbringer: When you immobilize a champion or are immobilized within 400 units of an enemy champion, reveal all nearby enemy champions for 3 seconds, deal magic damage equal to 40 + 2.5% bonus Health, and gain 20% Armor and Magic Resist (3 second Cooldown).

Momentum: Moving builds Momentum, granting up to 40 Move Speed at 100 stacks. Attacking removes all Momentum. Stacks decay when movement is impaired.
Crushing Blow: Attacks deal up to 100 bonus magic damage based on Momentum removed. Melee attacks with max Momentum slow by 75% for 1 second.

Cauterize: Store 30% of physical and magic damage taken, or 12% for ranged champions, and take the stored amount as true damage over 3 seconds.
Defy: If a champion you damaged within the last 3 seconds dies, the remaining Cauterize damage is cleansed, and you heal over 2 seconds for an amount equal to 90% bonus Attack Damage.

Spellblade: After using an ability, your next attack within 10 seconds will deal 10% of the target's maximum Health as bonus physical damage (7% if the attack is ranged). If the target is a champion, heal for 6% of the target's maximum Health (2.5% if the attack is ranged). (1.5 second Cooldown) Damage is reduced vs structures.
Giant Slayer: Deal bonus damage based on the enemy champion's bonus Health, up to 12% bonus damage when the enemy champion has 1,200 bonus Health.

Spellblade: After casting an ability, your next attack deals bonus magic damage equal to 75% base Attack Damage + 10% Ability Power and heals you for 3% bonus Health + 10% Ability Power. Shortly afterward, it applies on-hit effects to the target 1 additional time. (1.5 second Cooldown)
Deals reduced damage to structures.

Nightstalker: Your first basic attack against an enemy champion deals 60–160 bonus physical damage and slows them by 99% for 0.35 seconds (10 second Cooldown).
Cooldown is refreshed when an enemy champion has been taken down.

Soul Siphon: Store 30% of pre-mitigation damage dealt to enemy champions as Soul Fragments, capped at 80–250 based on level. Healing or shielding an ally spends all fragments to heal that ally for the stored amount.

Ever Rising Moon: Hitting an enemy champion with 2 separate attacks or abilities within 1.8 seconds deals bonus physical damage equal to 7% of the target's Max Health (3.5% for ranged champions), and grants you a shield that absorbs damage equal to 150 + 40% bonus Attack Damage (70 + 18% bonus Attack Damage for ranged champions) for 2 seconds (6 second Cooldown).
Annul: Grants a spell shield that blocks the next enemy ability (35 second Cooldown).

Rend: Physical damage inflicts 40% Grievous Wounds to enemy champions for 3 seconds.

Hexcharged: Gain 20 Ultimate Ability Haste.
Overdrive: After casting your ultimate ability, gain 40% Attack Speed and 20% Move Speed for 8 seconds (30 second Cooldown).

Kindle: Damaging abilities deal 5 bonus magic damage over 3 seconds.

Night Vigil: Gain 20 Ultimate Ability Haste.
Opening Barrage: For 8 seconds after casting your ultimate, your next 3 attacks gain 50% Attack Speed and guaranteed critical strikes at 80% of normal critical damage. An attack that would already crit instead gains 15% bonus true damage (45 second Cooldown).

Converge: Gain 10 Ultimate Ability Haste.
Frostfire Tempest: Casting your ultimate ability summons a storm around you for 5 seconds. The storm deals 150 total magic damage to enemy champions within 350 units and slows them by 30%. If no enemy champion is in range when the ultimate is cast, the storm is delayed until an enemy champion enters range or up to 5 seconds later (30 second Cooldown).
Stasis (Active): Become immune to damage and untargetable for 2.5 seconds, but you cannot move, attack, cast abilities, or use items during this time. (90 second Cooldown)
